description: Read-only: collect errors and warnings across a network and cluster them by message, severity type, or parent container, with the nodes that have the most diagnostics and a suggested order to investigate. Returns {total, error_count, warning_count, groups[], suggestions[]}; each group sample retains its error/warning severity. Use this for network-wide triage instead of reading every node's diagnostics one by one; use get_td_node_errors when you want the raw list for one node or sub-tree.

group_by.description: How to cluster diagnostics: by exact message, by severity type (error/warning), or by parent container.

path.description: Network root to collect diagnostics under.

name: summarize_td_errors

count.description: How many diagnostics fall into this cluster.

key.description: The shared message, type, or parent path for this cluster.

sample.description: One representative diagnostic from the cluster.

message.description: That node's diagnostic message, as a concrete example.

path.description: Path of one representative node in this cluster.
The network root diagnostics were collected under.

suggestions.description: Plain-language next steps, including which nodes to inspect first.

total.description: Total number of diagnostics found across the network (errors + warnings).

title: Summarize network errors
